title: Tidekin cross-genre Steam evidence
method: Review figures are literal observations from official Steam store-page results or opened Steam pages retrieved for this research. Counts are Steam user reviews, not unit sales or player counts. Steam results may be cached and counts change. Variants are preserved where the retrieved official snippets disagreed; the Markdown rounds counts and omits an uncertain rating rather than choosing one.
